name: tellandgo
title: Tell & Go
description: Book real travel from any AI agent. Search, quote, and book curated hotel & resort stays with all-in, transfer-inclusive pricing identical to tellandgo.com. No account required; the traveler pays on Tell & Go's own checkout at tellandgo.com.

tools.name: search_stays
tools.description: Natural-language search over bookable hotel & resort inventory; returns matches with all-in, transfer-inclusive nightly pricing. No account or API key required.

tools.name: get_stay_details
tools.description: Full detail for one property: rooms, amenities, location, policies, and indicative pricing.

tools.name: get_price_facts
tools.description: Read-only published price facts: the dated sample totals a resort's answer page shows (room, meal plan, transfer, taxes, cancellation, date checked). Not a quote; use get_quote for the traveler's own dates.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: A live, dated quote for a specific stay + dates + guests; the exact all-in total, matching the website.

tools.name: prebook_stay
tools.description: Optional. Re-checks the quoted rate and terms with the supplier before checkout. It does not hold the rate.

tools.name: start_booking
tools.description: From a quote_id and the traveler's residency, returns a checkout link on tellandgo.com where the traveler enters guest details and pays. The agent never handles card data.

tools.name: save_quote
tools.description: Sends a stay the traveler is considering, with their contact details, to the Tell & Go team so a person follows up. Only after the traveler explicitly agreed to be contacted; nothing is booked, held or charged.

tools.name: request_callback
tools.description: Asks the Tell & Go team to contact the traveler by email or phone. Only after the traveler explicitly agreed to be contacted; nothing is booked, held or charged.
